views.name: Quick Reads
views.query: (minutes__lt:10 OR minutes:10) AND (in:inbox OR in:later) AND category__not:video AND category__not:email AND has__not:tags

views.name: Long Reads
views.query: minutes__gt:10 AND (in:inbox OR in:later) AND category__not:epub AND category__not:email AND category__not:video AND has__not:tags
